text: The doctor is skilled, doesn't push sales of courses, and the prices are fair.😃 …

Fantastic experience here. Had three skin tags that have been causing me some annoyance. Popped in yesterday, made an appointment to see the doctor the following day.

Arrived punctually for my appointment and was seen immediately.

The doctor is fantastic. She is very skilled and quick to remove the skin tags. I felt absolutely no pain. These skin tags had been worrying me for a few years and in less than 10 minutes they are gone and no longer a worry.

I highly recommend the Lollana Clinic.

Alert for scam! They have obviously 2 different price lists. One price list is displayed on the wall at the reception, another price list (50% higher pricing) is presented to you when you have to make the payment after your treatment. They state that price list on the wall is from an old promotion(!). This is SCAM and illegal.
I did microdermabrasion, the price displayed on the wall (no promotion mentioned) was 600 THB, after the treatment they showed me their menu where the price was 1000 THB.  Outrageous!
Never going back and do not recommend to anyone. The doctor was way too keen on selling me various treatments, even if I explained that I want to take things slow and not do any invasive treatments.
